entries.title: I Corinthians 3:1
segments: ¶And I, brethren, could not speak to you as to spiritual [people] but as to carnal, as to babes in Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:2
segments: I fed you with milk and not with solid food; for until now you were not able [to receive it], and even now you are still not able;

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:3
segments: for you are still carnal. For where [there are] envy, strife, and divisions among you, are you not carnal and behaving like [mere] men?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:4
segments: For when one says, "I am of Paul," and another, "I [am] of Apollos," are you not carnal?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:5
segments: ¶Who then is Paul, and who [is] Apollos, but ministers through whom you believed, as the Lord gave to each one?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:6
segments: I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the increase.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:7
segments: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:8
segments: Now he who plants and he who waters are one, and each one will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:9
segments: For we are God's fellow workers; you are God's field, [you are] God's building.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:10
segments: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I have laid the foundation, and another builds on it. But let each one take heed how he builds on it.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:11
segments: ¶For no other foundation can anyone lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:12
segments: Now if anyone builds on this foundation [with] gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw,

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:13
segments: each one's work will become clear; for the Day will declare it, because it will be revealed by fire; and the fire will test each one's work, of what sort it is.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:14
segments: If anyone's work which he has built on [it] endures, he will receive a reward.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:15
segments: If anyone's work is burned, he will suffer loss; but he himself will be saved, yet so as through fire.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:16
segments: ¶Do you not know that you are the temple of God and [that] the Spirit of God dwells in you?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:17
segments: If anyone defiles the temple of God, God will destroy him. For the temple of God is holy, which [temple] you are.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:18
segments: ¶Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you seems to be wise in this age, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:19
segments: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, "He catches the wise in their [own] craftiness";

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:20
segments: and again, "The LORD knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are futile."

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:21
segments: ¶Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours:

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:22
segments: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas, or the world or life or death, or things present or things to come--all are yours.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:23
segments: And you [are] Christ's, and Christ [is] God's.
